BonsaiAPIKeyCredential.title: Bonsai API Key
BonsaiAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: Create an API key in your Bonsai settings, then paste it here. The key acts with your Bonsai member's permissions.

BonsaiMcpCredential.description: Bonsai connected through Bonsai's MCP server: agents get its tools.

default_contact_id.description: Id of the contact to make this company's primary point of contact. Must be a contact in your account — find one with `GET /public-api/v1/contacts`.
default_contact_id.title: Default Contact Id

description.description: Free text notes about the company.
description.title: Description

industry.description: The industry the company operates in. Must be one of the listed values.
industry.title: Industry

company_size.description: Headcount band for the company. Must be one of the listed values.
company_size.title: Company Size

source.description: How the client was acquired. Must be one of the listed values.
source.title: Source

linkedin.description: Link to the company's LinkedIn profile.
linkedin.title: Linkedin

instagram.description: Link to the company's Instagram profile.
instagram.title: Instagram

twitter.description: Link to the company's X profile.
twitter.title: Twitter

facebook.description: Link to the company's Facebook page.
facebook.title: Facebook

domains.description: Domains to associate with the company. Each value is lowercased and stripped of any protocol or `www.` prefix before it is stored. A domain can belong to only one company in your account; claiming one that is already taken fails with `422`.
domains.title: Domains

email.description: Email address. Required, and must be unique among your contacts.
email.title: Email

company_id.description: Id of the company to link the contact to. Find one with `GET /public-api/v1/companies`.
company_id.title: Company Id

company_id.description: Id of the client company the deal is with. Required.
company_id.title: Company Id

contact_id.description: Id of a contact at that company to attach to the deal. Defaults to the company's primary contact.
contact_id.title: Contact Id

assignee_member_id.description: Who owns the deal: a team member id, or `me` for whoever the token belongs to. Send `null` or leave it out for an unassigned deal.
assignee_member_id.title: Assignee Member Id

board_group_id.description: Id of the pipeline stage to put the deal in. Defaults to the first stage of your deal board.
board_group_id.title: Board Group Id

deal_value.description: What the deal is worth, as a decimal string. Must be zero or greater.
deal_value.title: Deal Value

company_id.description: Id of the client company to invoice. Leave it out to bill the contact on their own, with no company on the invoice. Must be a company in your account.
company_id.title: Company Id

contact_id.description: Id of the contact to address the invoice to. Required. Must be a contact in your account; without `company_id` it is the person billed, and can't be a supplier's contact.
contact_id.title: Contact Id

project_id.description: Id of the project to invoice. Leave it out for an invoice with no project. Needs `company_id`, and must already exist and belong to that company.
project_id.title: Project Id

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code. Defaults to the project's currency, or to your account's currency when there is no project; send it to override.
currency.title: Currency

title.description: Invoice title shown to the client. Defaults to the client name followed by "Invoice".
title.title: Title

due.description: When payment is due. Leave it out to use your account's default payment terms, which may work out to a number of days after issue.
due.title: Due

due_date.description: The exact date payment is due. Required when `due` is `custom`, and must be left out when `due` is `upon_receipt`.
due_date.title: Due Date

company_id.description: Id of the client company the project is for. Required.
company_id.title: Company Id

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code the project bills in. Defaults to the client's currency.
currency.title: Currency

start_date.description: Date work starts. Defaults to today.
start_date.title: Start Date

finish_date.description: Date work ends. Left open when omitted.
finish_date.title: Finish Date

billing_type.description: How the project bills. Required. See the table above for which fee fields each type takes.
billing_type.title: Billing Type

billing_fee.description: The agreed fee, as a decimal string. Required for `fixed_fee` and `retainer`, rejected for the other types.
billing_fee.title: Billing Fee

billing_cycle.description: How often a retainer bills. Required for `retainer`, rejected for the other types.
billing_cycle.title: Billing Cycle

project_id.description: Id of the project the task belongs to. Leave it out for a task that stands on its own. Cannot be combined with `parent_task_uuid` — a subtask takes its project from its parent. Find one with `GET /public-api/v1/projects`.
project_id.title: Project Id

deal_id.description: Id of the deal to put the task on. Independent of `project_id` — a task can sit on a deal, a project, both or neither. Needs permission to create deals; without it the request fails with `422 not_accessible`. A deal that is not in your account fails the same way. Find one with `GET /public-api/v1/deals`.
deal_id.title: Deal Id

parent_task_uuid.description: `uuid` of the task to nest this one under. The subtask takes its project and billable setting from the parent, so `project_id` cannot be sent with it. A parent that is not in your account fails with `422 not_accessible`; a parent already two levels deep fails with `422 invalid_value`.
parent_task_uuid.title: Parent Task Uuid

assignee_member_id.description: Who the task is for: a team member id, or `me` for whoever the token belongs to. Send `null` or leave it out for an unassigned task. Find ids with `GET /public-api/v1/team_members` — use the `company_member_id` field.
assignee_member_id.title: Assignee Member Id

due_date.description: Date the task is due. Leave it out for an unscheduled task. Cannot be earlier than `start_date` when you send both.
due_date.title: Due Date

start_date.description: Date work on the task starts. Cannot be later than `due_date` when you send both.
start_date.title: Start Date

description.description:
What the task involves. Accepts an HTML fragment for formatting — `

`, ``, `

    `/`
  • ` and `` among others. Read it back as `description_html` (sanitized) or `description_plain_text` (tags removed) on single-task responses; neither appears in a list.
description.title: Description

time_estimate_in_minutes.description: Estimated effort in whole minutes — 90 for an hour and a half. Must be positive.
time_estimate_in_minutes.title: Time Estimate In Minutes

task_status_id.description: Id of the board column to put the task in. Defaults to your `To Do` column. Find one with `GET /public-api/v1/task_statuses`.
task_status_id.title: Task Status Id

billable.description: Whether time tracked on the task is billable. Left out, it defaults the way the app does: a subtask inherits its parent, a task on a not-billable project is not billable, and everything else is billable. Only honoured for a token allowed to set billing, on a plan that includes task billing — otherwise the value is ignored and the default applies. `permissions.tasks.billing_update` from `GET /public-api/v1/permissions/me` tells you which you have; note that `permissions.tasks.billing` only covers reading it back.
billable.title: Billable

tag_ids.description: Tags to put on the task. Must be `task` tags from your account — find them with `GET /public-api/v1/company_tags`. Read them back under `company_tags`.
tag_ids.title: Tag Ids

seconds.description: How long the work took, in seconds. Required.
seconds.title: Seconds

date.description: The day the work was done. Required.
date.title: Date

project_id.description: Id of the project to log against. Ignored when you also send `task_uuid`. Sample projects are not accepted. Find one with `GET /public-api/v1/projects`.
project_id.title: Project Id

task_uuid.description: `uuid` of the task to log against. The project is taken from the task. Tasks on sample projects, and template tasks, are not accepted. Find one with `GET /public-api/v1/tasks`.
task_uuid.title: Task Uuid

notes.description: What the time was spent on.
notes.title: Notes

rate.description: Hourly rate to bill at, as a decimal string. Must be zero or greater. Only honoured for a token allowed to set billing; otherwise it comes from the project or member rate.
rate.title: Rate

non_billable.description: Whether to exclude the entry from billing. Only honoured for a token allowed to set billing; otherwise it comes from the task or project's billing type.
non_billable.title: Non Billable

owner_member_id.description: Who the time is for: a team member id, or `me` for whoever the token belongs to. Defaults to the token's own member. Logging for someone else needs permission to manage the whole team's time. Find ids with `GET /public-api/v1/team_members`.
owner_member_id.title: Owner Member Id

filter_title.title: Filter Title

filter_public_url_token.description: One or more URL tokens, comma-separated or repeated.
filter_public_url_token.title: Filter Public Url Token

filter_board_group_id.description: One or more pipeline stage ids, comma-separated or repeated. Returns the projects whose board card sits in those stages.
filter_board_group_id.title: Filter Board Group Id

filter_status.description: Which projects to include. Defaults to `active`.
filter_status.title: Filter Status

filter_has_budget.description: Return only projects that do (`true`) or do not (`false`) track a budget. Needs permission to see budgets; without it this filter returns 403.

filter_assignee_id.title: Filter Assignee Id

filter_due.description: A named due-date window. Cannot be combined with `filter[due_from]` or `filter[due_to]`.

filter_deal_id.description: One or more deal ids, comma-separated or repeated. Needs permission to see deals; without it this filter returns 403.

filter_tag_id.description: One or more tag ids, comma-separated or repeated.

page_size.title: Page Size

filter_date_from.description: Return entries dated on or after this day.
filter_date_from.title: Filter Date From

filter_date_to.description: Return entries dated on or before this day.

filter_owner_member_id.description: One or more team member ids, comma-separated or repeated. Pass `me` for whoever the token belongs to. Reaching another member's time needs permission to see the whole team's time.

filter_currency.title: Filter Currency

default_contact_id.title: Default Contact Id

description.description: Free text notes about the company. Send `null` to clear it.
description.title: Description

industry.description: The industry the company operates in. Must be one of the listed values. Send `null` to clear it.

company_size.description: Headcount band for the company. Must be one of the listed values. Send `null` to clear it.

source.description: How the client was acquired. Must be one of the listed values. Send `null` to clear it.

linkedin.description: Link to the company's LinkedIn profile. Send `null` to clear it.

contact_id.description: Id of the contact to update.
contact_id.title: Contact Id

name.description: New full name. A contact must have a name, so `null` or an empty string is ignored rather than clearing it.
name.title: Name

email.description: New email address. A contact must have an email, so `null` or an empty string is ignored rather than clearing it. Must stay unique among your contacts.
email.title: Email

job_title.description: New job title. Send `null` or an empty string to clear it; leave the field out to keep it.
job_title.title: Job Title

phone_number.description: New phone number. Send `null` or an empty string to clear it; leave the field out to keep it.
phone_number.title: Phone Number

deal_id.description: Id of the deal to update.
deal_id.title: Deal Id

company_id.description: Id of the client company the deal is with. Find one with `GET /public-api/v1/companies`.
company_id.title: Company Id

contact_ids.description: The contacts on the deal, replacing whatever is there now. Send an empty array to remove them all. Leave the field out to keep the deal's current contacts.
contact_ids.title: Contact Ids

assignee_member_id.description: Who owns the deal: a team member id, or `me` for whoever the token belongs to. Send `null` to leave it unassigned.
assignee_member_id.title: Assignee Member Id

board_group_id.description: Id of the pipeline stage to move the deal to. Find one with `GET /public-api/v1/board_groups`.
board_group_id.title: Board Group Id

deal_value.description: What the deal is worth, as a decimal string. Must be zero or greater. `null` is ignored rather than clearing the value.
deal_value.title: Deal Value

probability.description: Chance of winning the deal, as a whole percentage from 0 to 100. `null` is ignored rather than clearing the value.
probability.title: Probability

close_date.description: Date the deal is expected to close. Send `null` to clear it.
close_date.title: Close Date

invoice_id.description: Id of the invoice to update.
invoice_id.title: Invoice Id

contact_id.description: Id of the contact to address the invoice to, which also refreshes the client name and email printed on it. Must be a contact at the invoice's client company. On an invoice with no company the contact is who it bills and can't change; create a new invoice to bill someone else.
contact_id.title: Contact Id

title.description: Invoice title shown to the client.
title.title: Title

due_date.description: The exact date payment is due. Required when `due` is `custom`, and must be left out when `due` is `upon_receipt`. Sending it on its own is treated as `custom`.
due_date.title: Due Date

title.description: Project title. A project must have one, so it cannot be blank.
title.title: Title

start_date.description: Date work starts. Cannot be cleared.
start_date.title: Start Date

finish_date.description: Date work ends. Send `null` to clear it.
finish_date.title: Finish Date

billing_type.description: How the project bills. See the table above for which fee fields each type takes.
billing_type.title: Billing Type

billing_fee.description: The agreed fee, as a decimal string. Send `null` to clear it.
billing_fee.title: Billing Fee

billing_cycle.description: How often a retainer bills. Send `null` to clear it.
billing_cycle.title: Billing Cycle

board_group_id.description: Id of the stage to move the project to, on the project board it already sits on.
board_group_id.title: Board Group Id

title.description: New task title. A task must have one, so it cannot be blank.
title.title: Title

project_id.description: Move the task to another project, or send `null` to detach it from the one it is on. Find one with `GET /public-api/v1/projects`.
project_id.title: Project Id

deal_id.description: Move the task to another deal, or send `null` to take it off the one it is on. Independent of `project_id`. Needs permission to create deals; without it the request fails with `422 not_accessible`. A deal that is not in your account fails the same way. Find one with `GET /public-api/v1/deals`.
deal_id.title: Deal Id

assignee_member_id.description: Who the task is for: a team member id, or `me` for whoever the token belongs to. Send `null` to unassign it. Find ids with `GET /public-api/v1/team_members` — use the `company_member_id` field.
assignee_member_id.title: Assignee Member Id

priority.description: How urgent the task is. Can be changed but not cleared once set.
priority.title: Priority

due_date.description: Date the task is due. Send `null` to clear it.
due_date.title: Due Date

start_date.description: Date work on the task starts. Send `null` to clear it.
start_date.title: Start Date

description.description: What the task involves, as an HTML fragment. Send `null` to clear it. Read it back as `description_html` or `description_plain_text`.
description.title: Description

time_estimate_in_minutes.description: Estimated effort in whole minutes. Must be positive, or `null` to clear it.
time_estimate_in_minutes.title: Time Estimate In Minutes

task_status_id.description: Id of the board column to move the task to. Find one with `GET /public-api/v1/task_statuses`.
task_status_id.title: Task Status Id

billable.description: Whether time tracked on the task is billable. Sent alongside `project_id`, your value wins over the new project's default; left out, moving the task to another project re-derives it from that project. Only honoured for a token allowed to set billing, on a plan that includes task billing — otherwise the value is ignored. Check `permissions.tasks.billing_update` from `GET /public-api/v1/permissions/me` before relying on it.
billable.title: Billable

tag_ids.description: The tags on the task, replacing whatever is there now. Send an empty array to remove them all. Must be `task` tags from your account — find them with `GET /public-api/v1/company_tags`.
tag_ids.title: Tag Ids

time_entry_key.description: The entry's `key`, as returned in a time entry response.
time_entry_key.title: Time Entry Key

seconds.description: How long the work took, in seconds.
seconds.title: Seconds

date.description: The day the work was done.
date.title: Date

project_id.description: Id of the project to log against, or `null` to detach the entry from the one it is on. Ignored while the entry is linked to a task. Sample projects are not accepted.
project_id.title: Project Id

task_uuid.description: `uuid` of the task to log against — the project comes with it. Send `null` to unlink the task, which also clears the project it brought.
task_uuid.title: Task Uuid

notes.description: What the time was spent on. Send an empty string to clear it.
notes.title: Notes

rate.description: Hourly rate to bill at, as a decimal string. Must be zero or greater. Only honoured for a token allowed to set billing.
rate.title: Rate

non_billable.description: Whether to exclude the entry from billing. Only honoured for a token allowed to set billing.
non_billable.title: Non Billable

billing_status.description: Mark the entry `billed`, or move it back to `unbilled`. Requires a token allowed to set billing — unlike `rate` and `non_billable`, a value here from a token without that permission fails the whole request with `422 not_accessible` rather than being ignored. `non_billable` is not accepted here — use the `non_billable` flag for that.
billing_status.title: Billing Status

owner_member_id.description: Who the time is for: a team member id, or `me` for whoever the token belongs to. Reassigning to someone else needs permission to manage the whole team's time.
owner_member_id.title: Owner Member Id
